label: Изучаемый
description: A 10-sentence card for изучаемый, the present passive participle of изучать.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative. Изучаемый comes from изучать — the first-conjugation form изучаем plus -ый. It agrees with masculine предмет and means the subject being studied.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative. The feminine ending -ая lets изучаемая agree with тема. The -ем- suffix marks the first conjugation, and the word names the topic being studied.

missions.phrase: Изучаемое явление до сих пор загадочно.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Neuter nominative. Изучаемое carries the neuter ending -ое to match явление. As a present passive participle it means the phenomenon that is being studied.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative. The plural ending -ые lets изучаемые agree with языки. The participle declines like an adjective and names the languages being studied.

Strategic focus: Masculine accusative. With the inanimate masculine object материал the participle keeps изучаемый as the material we review. Изучаемый материал equals материал, который изучают — the one people study.
Strategic focus: Feminine genitive. Изучаемой takes the feminine genitive ending to agree with местности, marking the area being studied as what the map shows.
Strategic focus: Masculine dative. The dative noun вопросу pulls изучаемому into the dative -ому ending. The word names the question being studied that gets an hour.
Strategic focus: Masculine instrumental. After занят the noun процессом stands in the instrumental, and изучаемым takes the matching instrumental ending to agree with the process being studied.

missions.phrase: Мы спорим об изучаемом периоде истории.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional. The preposition об governs the prepositional case, so периоде and изучаемом both take prepositional endings as the period being studied that we discuss.

missions.phrase: Глубоко изучаемые тексты раскрывают свои тайны.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Plural nominative paraphrase. Глубоко изучаемые тексты unfolds as тексты, которые глубоко изучают — texts that people study deeply. The participle folds that который-clause into one agreeing word.
